_comment: E7's effective configuration, expressed as ONE file for the first time.
Until now it existed only as the union of two run directories plus the
composition script e7_final_cascade_fold2_read.py, which is why the
collaborator could not be asked to match it: 'same architecture' was not
checkable. Sources, all verified against the artifacts:
gamma 0.01666667 is 0.5 / 30 features, the multiplier E4's grid selected.
Run with: ALGO=svm CLASS_WEIGHT=subtype ALPHA2=0.4 ALPHA3=0.5
REPRODUCTION CAVEAT: this reproduces E7's RECIPE, not E7's bytes. E7's
orchards expert was fitted on a population drawn from e4's own generator
(seed 777), whereas a single-script run draws it from the main seed-42
sequence. Same rule, different draw. Stage 2 does replay byte-identically,
because s2mass_stage2.py replayed the trainer's own RNG to get its pool.
